mock_data.title: Terrorism
mock_data.passage:
The whole world was stunned by the atrocities committed by terrorists in the United States. Their actions have rightly been condemned by many world leaders, who see the terrorist activities as a threat to democracy as well as a heinous crime against the United States.

Acts of terrorism are usually carried out, in part at least, to gain maximum publicity for the cause which the terrorists espouse. The terrorists who crashed planes into the World Trade Center buildings in New York certainly achieved such publicity. The second plane attack was even televised by world news teams at the actual moment of impact.

The need to gain publicity for their aims usually leads terrorist groups to admit to the acts of violence. This was not the case in the immediate aftermath of the American attack. No group seemed anxious to claim responsibility for the outrage. Frequently, too, in terrorist attacks on civilian targets, some kind of advance warning is given. This did not happen in New York and thousands of innocent lives were lost.

The United States spends a great deal of time and money on defence and intelligence. However, the country was taken completely by surprise by this attack. Many Americans had considered their powerful country to be invulnerable and were utterly shocked that terrorists could violate their security in this way.

There are many different groups of terrorists throughout the world, each motivated by different things. This may be a sense of political injustice, religious fervour or simply hatred of the people whom they attack. Often, they are an invisible enemy, who use stealth and secrecy to commit acts of brutality, and then disappear.

Most difficult to deal with are those terrorists who are prepared to die for their cause. Such is their fanatical hatred of the people whom they are attacking that they are prepared to commit suicide, so long as they inflict casualties on the enemy.

World leaders now realize the global nature of many modern issues. The need to eradicate terrorism is, surely, one of the most important of these.
mock_data.passageB1:
The world was very shocked by the terrible things that terrorists did in the United States. Many leaders around the world said these actions were very bad. They think terrorism is a danger to democracy and a very bad crime against the United States.

Terrorists often do these things to get attention for what they believe in. The terrorists who crashed planes into the World Trade Center in New York definitely got a lot of attention. The second plane attack was even shown on TV news around the world.

Terrorist groups usually admit they did the violent things to get attention. But after the attack in America, no group wanted to say they did it. Also, terrorists often give a warning before they attack civilians. This did not happen in New York, and many innocent people died.

The United States spends a lot of money on defence and intelligence. But the attack was a complete surprise. Many Americans thought their country was too strong to be attacked. They were very shocked that terrorists could threaten their safety in this way.

There are many different terrorist groups in the world. They all have different reasons for what they do. Some feel there is political injustice. Others are driven by their religious beliefs, or they simply hate the people they attack. They are often like an invisible enemy, using secret ways to do brutal things, and then they disappear.

The most difficult terrorists to deal with are those who are ready to die for what they believe in. They hate the people they attack so much that they are ready to commit suicide, as long as they hurt the enemy.

World leaders now understand that many problems are global. Stopping terrorism is one of the most important things to do.
mock_data.passageB2:
The world was horrified by the terrible acts of terrorism in the United States. These actions have been rightly condemned by leaders worldwide, who see such terrorist activities as a serious threat to democracy and a grave crime against the American people.

Terrorist acts are often deliberately designed to gain maximum publicity for the cause the terrorists support. The terrorists who crashed planes into the World Trade Center in New York certainly achieved widespread attention. The second plane attack was even broadcast live on television news channels around the globe, capturing the moment of impact.

The desire to publicise their aims usually leads terrorist groups to claim responsibility for acts of violence. However, immediately after the attack on America, no group stepped forward to take responsibility. Also, terrorist attacks on civilian targets often include some kind of warning. This was not the case in New York, and thousands of innocent people lost their lives.

The United States invests heavily in defence and intelligence. Yet, the country was completely taken by surprise by this attack. Many Americans had believed their powerful nation was invulnerable and were deeply shocked that terrorists could breach their security in such a way.

There are many different terrorist groups around the world, each driven by different motivations. These might include a feeling of political injustice, religious zeal, or simply hatred for those they attack. They are often a hidden enemy, using secrecy to commit brutal acts, and then disappearing without a trace.

The most difficult terrorists to deal with are those who are prepared to die for their cause. Their fanatical hatred of their targets means they are willing to commit suicide to inflict casualties on the enemy. World leaders now understand the global nature of many modern issues. The need to eliminate terrorism is, without doubt, one of the most important.
mock_data.passageC1:
The unconscionable acts perpetrated by terrorists on United States soil sent shockwaves across the globe. The international community has been unanimous in its condemnation, recognising these atrocities as not only a heinous assault on the American people, but also a profound threat to the very foundations of democracy. Indeed, terrorist acts are often calculated, at least in part, to garner maximum exposure for the ideological cause the perpetrators champion.

The terrorists responsible for the attacks on the World Trade Center in New York undeniably achieved this objective; the second plane's impact was even broadcast live, a spectacle witnessed by millions worldwide. However, the immediate aftermath of the attacks presented an anomaly. Contrary to standard practice, where terrorist groups typically claim responsibility to amplify their message, a conspicuous silence prevailed. Furthermore, the absence of any prior warning, a feature often associated with attacks on civilian targets, compounded the tragedy, resulting in an unprecedented loss of innocent life.

That a nation as powerful and technologically advanced as the United States, a country that invests heavily in defence and intelligence, could be caught so completely off guard was a source of profound disbelief. The attacks shattered the prevailing sense of American invulnerability, exposing a vulnerability that many had deemed inconceivable. The sheer audacity of the attacks served as a rude awakening.

The motivations underpinning terrorist activity are as diverse as the groups themselves. These can stem from perceived political injustices, religious extremism, or simply a deep-seated animosity towards the targeted population. Terrorists often operate as an insidious and elusive enemy, exploiting stealth and secrecy to commit their brutal acts before melting back into the shadows. This makes them exceptionally difficult to counteract.

Perhaps the most daunting challenge lies in confronting those terrorists who demonstrate a willingness to embrace martyrdom for their cause. Driven by a fanatical hatred, they are prepared to sacrifice their own lives, provided they can inflict significant casualties on their perceived enemy. The international community now fully appreciates the transnational nature of contemporary challenges, and the imperative to eradicate terrorism stands as one of the most pressing priorities on the global agenda. To that end, international cooperation must be bolstered to prevent future attacks and dismantle terrorist networks at their roots. The far-reaching consequences of inaction are simply too great to contemplate.

mock_data.translation:
Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlaridagi terrorchilar (terrorists) tomonidan sodir etilgan vaxshiyliklar (atrocities) butun dunyoni hayratda qoldirdi (stunned). Ularning harakatlari ko'plab dunyo yetakchilari tomonidan haqli ravishda qoralandi (condemned), ular terrorchilik faoliyatini demokratiyaga (democracy) tahdid, shuningdek, Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlariga qarshi sodir etilgan jirkanch (heinous) jinoyat deb bilishadi.

Terrorizm (terrorism) harakatlari odatda, hech bo'lmaganda qisman, terrorchilar qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan (espouse) maqsad (cause) uchun maksimal darajada ommaviylikka erishish uchun amalga oshiriladi. Nyu-Yorkdagi Butunjahon savdo markazi binolariga samolyotlarni urib yuborgan terrorchilar, shubhasiz, bunday ommaviylikka erishdilar. Ikkinchi samolyot hujumi hatto dunyo yangiliklar jamoalari tomonidan to'qnashuvning (impact) aynan o'sha lahzasida efirga uzatildi.

O'z maqsadlari uchun ommaviylikka erishish zarurati odatda terrorchi guruhlarni zo'ravonlik harakatlarini tan olishga majbur qiladi. Amerika hujumining bevosita oqibatlari (aftermath) davrida bunday bo'lmadi. Hech bir guruh ushbu dahshatli voqea (outrage) uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olishga shoshilmadi. Shuningdek, ko'pincha tinch aholi (civilian) nishonlariga qilingan terrorchilik hujumlarida qandaydir oldindan ogohlantirish beriladi. Nyu-Yorkda bunday bo'lmadi va minglab begunoh insonlar hayotdan ko'z yumdi.

Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari mudofaa va razvedka (intelligence) uchun juda ko'p vaqt va mablag' sarflaydi. Biroq, mamlakat ushbu hujumdan butunlay hayratda qoldi. Ko'pgina amerikaliklar o'zlarining qudratli davlatlarini yengilmas (invulnerable - shikast yetkazib bo'lmaydigan) deb hisoblashgan va terrorchilar ularning xavfsizligini shu tarzda buzishga muvaffaq bo'lganlaridan butunlay lol qolishgan.

Butun dunyoda ko'plab turli xil terrorchi guruhlar mavjud bo'lib, ularning har biri har xil narsalar bilan ruhlanadi/rag'batlantiriladi (motivated). Bu siyosiy adolatsizlik (injustice) tuyg'usi, diniy jo'shqinlik (fervour) yoki shunchaki ular hujum qilayotgan odamlarga bo'lgan nafrat bo'lishi mumkin. Ko'pincha, ular shafqatsizlik (brutality) harakatlarini sodir etish uchun ayyorlik (stealth) va maxfiylikdan foydalanadigan va keyin g'oyib bo'ladigan ko'rinmas dushmandir.

Ular bilan kurashish eng qiyini o'z maqsadlari yo'lida o'lishga tayyor bo'lgan terrorchilardir. Ularning hujum qilayotgan odamlariga bo'lgan nafrati shunchalik mutaassibona (fanatical)ki, ular dushmanga talofatlar yetkazish (inflict casualties) sharti bilan o'z joniga qasd qilishga (commit suicide) tayyordirlar.

Dunyo yetakchilari endi ko'plab zamonaviy muammolarning global xarakterga ega ekanligini tushunib yetishmoqda. Terrorizmni tag-tugi bilan yo'q qilish (eradicate) zarurati, shubhasiz, bularning eng muhimlaridan biridir.

mock_data.translationB1:
Dunyo terrorchilarning Qo'shma Shtatlarda qilgan dahshatli ishlaridan juda hayratda qoldi. Dunyo bo'ylab ko'plab rahbarlar bu harakatlar juda yomon ekanligini aytdi. Ular terrorizm demokratiya uchun xavf va Qo'shma Shtatlarga qarshi juda yomon jinoyat deb hisoblashadi.

Terrorchilar ko'pincha o'z e'tiqodlariga e'tibor qaratish uchun shunday ishlarni qiladilar. Nyu-Yorkdagi Jahon Savdo Markaziga samolyotlarni urib tushirgan terrorchilar albatta katta e'tibor qozondi. Hatto ikkinchi samolyot hujumi butun dunyo bo'ylab telekanallarda namoyish etildi.

Terroristik guruhlar odatda e'tibor qozonish uchun zo'ravonlik ishlarini qilganliklarini tan oladilar. Ammo Amerikadagi hujumdan so'ng, hech bir guruh buni qilganini aytishni xohlamadi. Shuningdek, terrorchilar ko'pincha fuqarolarga hujum qilishdan oldin ogohlantirish beradilar. Nyu-Yorkda bu sodir bo'lmadi va ko'plab begunoh odamlar halok bo'ldi.

Qo'shma Shtatlar mudofaa va razvedkaga juda ko'p pul sarflaydi. Ammo hujum butunlay kutilmagan bo'ldi. Ko'pgina amerikaliklar o'z mamlakati hujumga uchray olmaydigan darajada kuchli deb o'ylashardi. Terrorchilar ularning xavfsizligiga shu tarzda tahdid solishi mumkinligidan ular juda hayratda qolishdi.

Dunyoda turli xil terrorchilik guruhlari mavjud. Ularning barchasi o'z qilayotgan ishlariga turli xil sabablarga ega. Ba'zilar siyosiy adolatsizlik bor deb hisoblaydi. Boshqalarni o'z diniy e'tiqodlari boshqaradi yoki ular shunchaki hujum qiladigan odamlarni yomon ko'radilar. Ular ko'pincha ko'rinmas dushman kabi, shafqatsiz ishlarni qilish uchun maxfiy usullardan foydalanadilar va keyin g'oyib bo'lishadi.

Eng qiyin terrorchilar - bu o'z e'tiqodi uchun o'lishga tayyor bo'lganlardir. Ular hujum qiladigan odamlarni shunchalik yomon ko'rishadiki, dushmanga zarar yetkazishsa bo'ldi, o'z joniga qasd qilishga ham tayyor.

Dunyo rahbarlari endi ko'plab muammolar global ekanligini tushunishdi. Terrorizmni to'xtatish - eng muhim ishlardan biri.

Bu harakatlar butun dunyo bo'ylab yetakchilar tomonidan haqli ravishda qoralandi, ular bunday terrorchilik faoliyatini demokratiyaga jiddiy tahdid va Amerika xalqiga qarshi og'ir jinoyat sifatida baholaydilar.
